ko.title: 매장 앞 가격 충격: 자동차 할부금과 자동차보험이 운전자를 압박하는 이유

segments.src: For many American households, the car is the second-largest monthly expense after housing.
segments.tr: 미국의 많은 가구에게 자동차는 주거비 다음으로 큰 월간 지출이다.

segments.src: It is also one of the few that is hard to cut.
segments.tr: 또한 줄이기 어려운 몇 안 되는 지출 중 하나이기도 하다.

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들은 출근, 등교, 병원 진료를 위해 차량이 필요하다.

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: 최근 차량을 유지하는 비용이 여러 방면에서 한꺼번에 올랐다. 차량 출고가 상승, 비싼 금융 비용, 계속 오르는 보험료가 그것이다.

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 운전자들이 실제로 얼마를 지불하고 있는지, 그 인상의 배경에는 무엇이 있는지, 그리고 왜 점점 더 많은 차주가 상환에 어려움을 겪는지를 살펴본다.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: 수치는 대략적이며 발표된 업계 보고서를 바탕으로 한다.

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: 출처, 지역, 기간에 따라 정확한 수치는 다르므로, 재정 관련 결정을 내리기 전에 최신 데이터를 확인하라.

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## 일반적인 자동차 할부금의 모습

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: 에드먼즈(Edmunds)와 익스피리안(Experian) 같은 업계 추적 기관들은 최근 몇 년간 신차 대출의 월평균 상환액이 700달러를 훌쩍 넘는다고 보고해 왔다.

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: 중고차 할부금은 보통 500달러 이상인 경우가 많다.

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: 월 1,000달러 이상을 상환하는 신차 구매자도 점점 늘고 있다.

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: 이런 수치를 끌어올리는 요인은 여러 가지다:

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **차량 가격 상승.** 업계 추정에 따르면 신차 평균 거래가는 약 4만 8천 달러 근처이거나 그 이상에서 횡보하고 있다. 10년 전과 비교하면 훨씬 높은 수준이다.

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **대출 기간 장기화.** 72개월 또는 84개월짜리 대출이 이제 흔하다. 월 상환액은 낮아지지만 총 이자가 늘고, 차주가 차량 가치보다 더 많은 빚을 지는 기간이 길어진다.

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **대출 잔액 증가.** 많은 구매자가 보상판매 시 생기는 마이너스 자산(negative equity)을 새 대출에 합쳐서, 대출 원금이 그만큼 커진다.

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## 대출 금리: 이자율 효과

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: 2022년부터 연방준비제도(Fed)가 금리를 급격히 올리면서 자동차 대출 금리도 뒤따라 올랐다.

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: 신차 대출의 평균 금리는 대체로 중간 한 자릿수에서 7% 수준 사이였고, 중고차 대출은 10%를 넘는 경우가 많았다.

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: 신용점수가 낮은 차주는 두 자릿수 중반 이상의 금리에 직면할 수 있다.

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: 이것은 월 상환액에 큰 영향을 준다.

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: 4만 달러, 72개월 대출의 경우 금리 5%와 9%의 차이는 월 85~90달러 정도 더 내는 것이며, 대출 기간 전체로 보면 수천 달러에 이른다.

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: 금리 인하가 반영되기 시작하더라도 자동차 대출 금리는 천천히 내려가는 경향이 있으며, 대출기관은 위험도가 높은 차주에 대해 여전히 보수적인 심사 기준을 유지하고 있다.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## 관세와 차량 가격

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: 무역 정책은 또 하나의 불확실성을 더하고 있다.

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: 수입 완성차와 자동차 부품에 붙는 관세는 제조사와 부품 공급업체의 비용을 높인다.

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: 자동차 회사는 이 비용의 일부를 떠안거나, 구매자에게 전가하거나, 가격을 유지하기 위해 사양이나 트림 구성을 조정할 수 있다.

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: 이 비용이 소비자에게 얼마나, 그리고 얼마나 빨리 전달되는지에 대해서는 분석가들의 의견이 엇갈리지만, 대부분은 신차 가격과 수리비 모두에 상승 압력이 가해질 것으로 본다.

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: 관세의 영향은 전시장 밖에서도 나타난다.

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: 부품 가격이 오르면 충돌 사고 수리비도 더 비싸질 수 있다.

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: 이는 다시 보험사의 보험금 청구 비용으로 이어지며, 보험사는 이를 보험료를 책정할 때 고려한다.

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## 자동차보험은 계속 오르고 있다

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: 보험료는 차량 소유 비용을 지속적으로 끌어올린 요인 중 하나였다.

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: 소비자물가 자료에 따르면 지난 몇 년 동안 자동차보험료는 상당 기간 일반 물가상승률을 크게 웃돌며 올랐다.

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: 요금 조사에 따르면 완전 보장(full coverage) 자동차보험의 전국 평균 비용은 연간 약 2,000~2,700달러이며, 플로리다, 미시간, 루이지애나, 뉴욕 등의 주에서는 이보다 훨씬 높다.

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: 보험사들은 여러 이유를 든다:

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **수리비 상승.** 최신 차량에는 센서, 카메라, 첨단 전자장치가 들어 있다. 가벼운 접촉 사고도 수천 달러짜리 수리비로 이어질 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **보험금 청구 규모 증가.** 의료비와 차량 대체 가치가 올랐다.

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **악천후와 절도.** 우박, 홍수, 산불 같은 재해와 일부 지역의 차량 절도가 손실을 키웠다.

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **법률 및 사기 비용.** 일부 주에서는 소송 추세가 보험사의 지급액을 늘린다.

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: 대출기관은 할부 차량에 대해 완전 보장을 요구하기 때문에, 보험료 인상은 사실상 대출 비용에 포함되어 있다.

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## 종합해 보기

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: 월 약 750달러의 할부금에 월 200달러 이상의 보험료를 더하고, 여기에 연료나 충전비, 정비비, 등록비, 주차비를 포함하라.

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: 최신 차량을 가진 가구라면 총액이 월 1,200~1,500달러에 쉽게 이를 수 있다.

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: 중간 소득 가정에게 이는 세후 소득의 상당한 비중이다.

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## 왜 더 많은 운전자가 뒤처지고 있나

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: 연체 데이터가 그 부담을 보여준다.

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: 피치(Fitch)와 뉴욕 연방준비은행을 포함한 신용평가기관과 신용정보사의 보고서는 자동차 대출 연체율이 몇 년 만에 보지 못한 수준으로 올랐음을 보여준다.

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: 비우량(subprime) 차주의 연체는 특히 높은 수준이다.

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: 90일 이상 연체된 심각한 연체 잔액도 늘었다.

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: 원인으로는 다음이 있다:

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **빠듯한 가계 예산.** 식료품, 월세, 공과금 가격이 자동차 비용과 함께 올랐다.

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **최근 몇 년간 받은 고금리 대출.** 많은 차주가 금리가 정점일 때 비싼 금융 조건에 묶였다.

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **마이너스 자산.** 차량 가치보다 더 많은 빚을 진 소유자는 쉽게 팔거나 교환해서 빠져나올 수 없다.

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **학자금 대출 상환 재개.** 일부 차주에게는 상환이 다시 시작되면서 월 예산의 여유가 줄었다.

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: 일부 대출기관은 심사를 강화하는 방식으로 대응했으며, 압류(repossession)는 팬데믹 때의 저점에서 다시 늘었다.

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## 운전자가 할 수 있는 것

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: 즉각적인 해결책은 없지만, 부담을 줄일 수 있는 몇 가지 방법이 있다:

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **먼저 대출 조건을 비교하라.** 딜러를 방문하기 전에 신용협동조합, 은행, 온라인 대출기관의 제안을 비교하라. 금리가 1%포인트만 낮아져도 수백 달러를 아낄 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **월 상환액만이 아니라 총비용을 고려하라.** 대출 기간이 길면 월 상환액은 줄지만 총 이자는 늘어난다.

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **인증 중고차(CPO)나 약간 연식이 지난 모델을 살펴보라.** 가격과 보험료를 모두 줄일 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **보험은 매년 비교하라.** 같은 운전자와 차량이라도 보험사마다 요금이 크게 다를 수 있다. 할인 혜택, 높은 자기부담금, 주행거리 연동(usage-based) 프로그램에 대해 문의하라.

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **힘들다면 대출기관과 일찍 상담하라.** 대출기관은 상환 유예, 조건 변경 등 다른 선택지를 제시할 수 있다. 연체 후까지 기다리면 선택지가 줄어든다.

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **재융자를 고려하라.** 대출을 받은 이후 신용이 좋아졌거나 금리가 내려갔다면 재융자로 월 상환액을 낮출 수 있다. 수수료를 확인하고, 결국 더 많이 내게 될 만큼 기간을 늘리지는 마라.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: 자동차를 소유하는 월 비용에는 높은 차량 가격, 비싼 신용 비용, 오르는 보험료가 합쳐져 반영되어 있다.

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: 관세와 수리비는 불확실성을 더한다.

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: 많은 가구에게 그 결과는 예상치 못한 지출을 감당할 여유가 거의 없는 예산이며, 연체율 증가는 점점 더 많은 사람이 한계에 다다르고 있음을 시사한다.

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: 구매 예정자는 광고된 월 상환액만이 아니라 전체 소유 비용을 기준으로 계획을 세움으로써 스스로를 지킬 수 있다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and is not financial, legal or insurance advice.
segments.tr: *이 글은 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며 재정, 법률 또는 보험에 관한 조언이 아니다.

segments.src: Consult a qualified professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: 자신의 상황에 대해서는 자격을 갖춘 전문가와 상담하라.*

zh.title: 停车场上的价格冲击：为何车贷与车险正挤压车主

segments.src: For many American households, the car is the second-largest monthly expense after housing.
segments.tr: 对许多美国家庭而言，汽车是仅次于住房的第二大月度开支。

segments.src: It is also one of the few that is hard to cut.
segments.tr: 它也是少数很难削减的开支之一。

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: 大多数人需要车辆去上班、上学和看病。

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: 近来，拥有一辆车的成本在多个方面同时上升：车辆标价提高、融资成本高昂，保险费也持续上涨。

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: 本文将探讨车主实际支付的费用、涨价背后的原因，以及为何越来越多的借款人难以维持还款。

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: 数据为近似值，取自已公布的行业报告。

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: 具体数字因来源、地区和时间段而异，做出财务决定前请核对最新数据。

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## 典型的汽车月供是什么样的

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: Edmunds 和 Experian 等行业数据机构近年来报告称，新车贷款的平均月供远高于 700 美元。

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: 二手车月供通常在 500 美元以上。

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: 越来越多的新车买家每月还款额达到 1,000 美元或以上。

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: 推动这些数字上升的因素有几个：

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **车价上涨。** 根据行业估计，新车平均成交价接近或超过 48,000 美元，远高于十年前。

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **贷款期限延长。** 72 个月或 84 个月的贷款如今很常见。它们降低了月供，但增加了总利息，并使买家在更长时间内欠款高于车辆价值。

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **贷款本金增加。** 许多买家会把以旧车抵价换新车时的负资产并入新贷款，从而增加了融资总额。

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## 借贷成本：利率的影响

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: 美联储自 2022 年起大幅加息，汽车贷款利率随之上升。

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: 新车贷款的平均利率大体在中个位数至 7% 左右，而二手车贷款利率常超过 10%。

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: 信用评分较低的借款人，利率甚至可能达到两位数以上。

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: 这对月供的影响很大。

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: 以 40,000 美元、72 个月的贷款为例，5% 利率与 9% 利率之间的差距约为每月多出 85 至 90 美元，整个贷款期内相差数千美元。

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: 即使降息开始逐步传导，汽车贷款利率通常也回落缓慢，而且对于风险较高的借款人，贷款机构仍保持审慎的授信标准。

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## 关税与车价

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: 贸易政策又增加了一层不确定性。

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: 进口车辆和汽车零部件的关税提高了制造商和供应商的成本。

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: 汽车厂商可能自行消化部分成本，也可能转嫁给买家，或调整配置和车型等级以维持价格。

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: 分析人士对于成本有多少传导至消费者、传导速度有多快看法不一，但大多数人预计新车价格和维修费用都将承受上行压力。

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: 关税的影响也不止于展厅。

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: 零部件价格上涨会使碰撞维修更加昂贵。

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: 这反过来又推高保险理赔成本，而保险公司在制定保费时会将其纳入考量。

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## 汽车保险持续上涨

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: 保险一直是拥车成本持续攀升的主要因素之一。

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: 过去几年的大部分时间里，消费者价格数据显示汽车保险价格的涨幅远高于整体通胀。

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: 费率调查显示，全美全险的平均年费约为 2,000 至 2,700 美元，而在佛罗里达、密歇根、路易斯安那和纽约等州，费用要高得多。

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: 保险公司给出了几个原因：

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **维修成本更高。** 现代车辆配备了传感器、摄像头和先进电子设备。一次轻微剐蹭就可能产生数千美元的维修账单。

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **单次理赔金额更高。** 医疗费用和车辆重置价值都有所上升。

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **恶劣天气与盗窃。** 冰雹、洪水和野火等灾害，以及部分地区的车辆盗窃，推高了损失。

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **法律与欺诈成本。** 在一些州，诉讼趋势进一步增加了保险公司的赔付支出。

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: 由于贷款机构要求贷款购车必须投保全险，保费上涨实际上已计入借贷成本之中。

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## 综合来看

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: 把约 750 美元的月供，加上每月 200 美元或以上的保险费，再算上油费或充电费、保养、年检注册和停车费。

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: 对于拥有较新车型的家庭来说，总支出很容易达到每月 1,200 至 1,500 美元。

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: 对于收入处于中位数水平的家庭而言，这占据了税后收入的相当大一部分。

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## 为何越来越多的车主开始落后

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: 逾期数据反映了这种压力。

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: 包括 Fitch 和纽约联邦储备银行在内的信用机构与评级机构的报告显示，汽车贷款逾期率已升至多年来未曾见过的水平。

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: 次级借款人的逾期还款情况尤为严重。

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: 严重逾期的余额，即逾期 90 天或以上的部分，也有所增加。

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: 促成这一局面的因素包括：

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **预算吃紧。** 食品杂货、房租和水电费的价格与车辆成本一同上涨。

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **近年借入的高利率贷款。** 许多借款人是在利率处于高位时锁定了高成本融资。

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **负资产。** 欠款高于车辆价值的车主，难以通过出售或置换来摆脱困境。

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **学生贷款恢复还款。** 对部分借款人而言，学生贷款重新开始偿还，压缩了月度预算空间。

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: 贷款机构在某些情况下收紧了审批标准，而收回车辆的案例也从疫情期间的低点回升。

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## 车主可以做些什么

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: 没有立竿见影的办法，但以下一些措施可以减轻压力：

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **先比较贷款方案。** 在去经销商之前，先比较信用合作社、银行和网络贷款机构的报价。即使利率只降低一个百分点，也可能节省数百美元。

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **关注总成本，而不只是月供。** 较长的期限虽然降低了月供，却会提高总利息。

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **考虑认证二手车或稍旧的车型。** 这既能降低车价，也能降低保险费用。

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **每年比价保险。** 同一驾驶人和车辆在不同保险公司的报价可能相差很大。可询问相关优惠、更高的免赔额以及按使用量计费的方案。

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **如果已经吃紧，尽早与贷款机构沟通。** 贷款机构可能提供延期还款、调整还款条件等选择。等到错过还款后再沟通，可选的余地就会变小。

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **考虑再融资。** 如果你的信用已经改善，或者自贷款以来利率已经下降，再融资可能会降低月供。注意留意相关手续费，并避免把期限拉得过长，以免最终支付更多。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 结语

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: 拥车的月度成本，反映了车价上涨、融资成本高企和保费攀升三者的共同压力。

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: 关税和维修成本则带来了进一步的不确定性。

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: 对许多家庭来说，结果是预算几乎没有应对意外的余地，而逾期率上升也表明，越来越多的人已接近极限。

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: 购车者若想保护自己，应当以整体拥车成本为依据做规划，而不能只看广告中宣传的月供。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成财务、法律或保险建议。

segments.src: Consult a qualified professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: 如涉及个人具体情况，请咨询合格的专业人士。*

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like

segments.tr: नए वाहन ऋण की औसत दरें आम तौर पर मध्य-एकल अंकों से लेकर लगभग 7% तक रही हैं, जबकि इस्तेमाल किए गए वाहनों के ऋण पर दरें अक्सर 10% से ऊपर होती हैं।

segments.tr: कम क्रेडिट स्कोर वाले उधारकर्ताओं को दोहरे अंकों की दरों का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.tr: $40,000 के 72-महीने के ऋण पर, 5% और 9% दर के बीच का अंतर लगभग $85 से $90 प्रति माह अधिक है, या ऋण की पूरी अवधि में कई हज़ार डॉलर।

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: ब्याज दरों में कटौती का असर धीरे-धीरे पहुँचने लगे, तब भी ऑटो ऋण की दरें आम तौर पर धीरे-धीरे नरम होती हैं, और अधिक जोखिम वाले उधारकर्ताओं के लिए उधारदाताओं ने सावधान क्रेडिट मानदंड बनाए रखे हैं।

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## टैरिफ़ और कारों की कीमत

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: व्यापार नीति ने अनिश्चितता की एक और परत जोड़ी है।

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: आयातित वाहनों और ऑटो पार्ट्स पर टैरिफ़ निर्माताओं और आपूर्तिकर्ताओं की लागत बढ़ाते हैं।

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: ऑटोमेकर्स इस लागत का कुछ हिस्सा खुद वहन कर सकते हैं, खरीदारों पर डाल सकते हैं, या कीमतें स्थिर रखने के लिए फ़ीचर और ट्रिम स्तर बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक इस पर असहमत रहे हैं कि लागत का कितना हिस्सा उपभोक्ताओं तक पहुँचता है और कितनी जल्दी, लेकिन ज़्यादातर को उम्मीद है कि नए वाहनों की कीमतों और मरम्मत लागत दोनों पर ऊपर की ओर दबाव रहेगा।

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: टैरिफ़ शोरूम के बाहर भी मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: पार्ट्स महँगे होने से टक्कर की मरम्मत और महँगी हो सकती है।

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: इससे बीमा दावों की लागत भी बढ़ती है, जिसे बीमाकर्ता प्रीमियम तय करते समय ध्यान में रखते हैं।

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## ऑटो बीमा लगातार बढ़ रहा है

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: बीमा उन कारकों में से रहा है जो स्वामित्व की बढ़ती लागत में लगातार योगदान देते रहे हैं।

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता मूल्य आँकड़े दिखाते हैं कि पिछले कुछ वर्षों के बड़े हिस्से में ऑटो बीमा की कीमतें सामान्य मुद्रास्फीति से कहीं तेज़ दर से बढ़ी हैं।

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: दरों के सर्वेक्षण बताते हैं कि फ़ुल-कवरेज बीमा की औसत लागत राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर लगभग $2,000 से $2,700 प्रति वर्ष है, और फ़्लोरिडा, मिशिगन, लुइज़ियाना और न्यूयॉर्क जैसे राज्यों में यह आँकड़े कहीं अधिक हैं।

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ता कई कारण बताते हैं:

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **महँगी मरम्मत।** आधुनिक वाहनों में सेंसर, कैमरे और उन्नत इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स होते हैं। एक मामूली फ़ेंडर-बेंडर भी हज़ारों डॉलर का मरम्मत बिल बन सकता है।

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **दावों की ऊँची गंभीरता।** चिकित्सा खर्च और वाहन की प्रतिस्थापन कीमत बढ़ गई है।

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **गंभीर मौसम और चोरी।** ओले, बाढ़ और जंगल की आग की घटनाएँ, और कुछ क्षेत्रों में वाहन चोरी ने नुकसान बढ़ा दिया है।

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **कानूनी और धोखाधड़ी की लागत।** कुछ राज्यों में मुकदमेबाज़ी के रुझान बीमाकर्ताओं द्वारा दी जाने वाली राशि को और बढ़ाते हैं।

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: चूँकि उधारदाता वित्तपोषित वाहनों पर फ़ुल कवरेज अनिवार्य करते हैं, इसलिए ऊँचे प्रीमियम प्रभावी रूप से उधार की लागत में शामिल हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## सब को जोड़कर

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: लगभग $750 का भुगतान और $200 या उससे अधिक का बीमा बिल जोड़ें, फिर ईंधन या चार्जिंग, रखरखाव, पंजीकरण और पार्किंग जोड़ें।

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: नई गाड़ी वाले परिवार के लिए कुल आसानी से $1,200 से $1,500 प्रति माह तक पहुँच सकता है।

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: मध्यम आय कमाने वाले परिवार के लिए, यह वेतन का एक बड़ा हिस्सा है।

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## अधिक ड्राइवर पीछे क्यों छूट रहे हैं

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: भुगतान में चूक (डिलिंक्वेंसी) के आँकड़े इस दबाव को दर्शाते हैं।

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: Fitch और Federal Reserve Bank of New York सहित क्रेडिट ब्यूरो और रेटिंग एजेंसियों की रिपोर्टों ने दिखाया है कि ऑटो ऋण में भुगतान चूक वर्षों में न देखे गए स्तरों तक बढ़ गई है।

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: सबप्राइम उधारकर्ताओं में देर से भुगतान विशेष रूप से ऊँचे रहे हैं।

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: गंभीर रूप से बकाया राशियाँ, यानी 90 दिन या उससे अधिक देर वाली, भी बढ़ी हैं।

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: योगदान देने वाले कारकों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **तंग बजट।** किराने, किराए और उपयोगिताओं की कीमतें कार के खर्चों के साथ-साथ बढ़ी हैं।

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **हाल के वर्षों में लिए गए उच्च-दर वाले ऋण।** कई उधारकर्ता दरें अपने चरम पर होने के समय महँगी वित्तपोषण व्यवस्था में बंध गए।

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **नकारात्मक इक्विटी।** जो मालिक वाहन की कीमत से अधिक बकाया रखते हैं, वे आसानी से बेचकर या ट्रेड करके बाहर नहीं निकल सकते।

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **छात्र ऋण भुगतान फिर से शुरू।** कुछ उधारकर्ताओं के लिए, फिर से शुरू हुए भुगतानों ने मासिक बजट में गुंजाइश घटा दी है।

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: कुछ मामलों में उधारदाताओं ने सख्त अंडरराइटिंग से प्रतिक्रिया दी है, जबकि महामारी के निचले स्तर से वाहन जब्ती (रिपोज़ेशन) बढ़ी है।

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## ड्राइवर क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: कोई त्वरित समाधान नहीं है, लेकिन कुछ कदम दबाव कम कर सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **पहले वित्तपोषण के विकल्प देखें।** डीलर के पास जाने से पहले क्रेडिट यूनियनों, बैंकों और ऑनलाइन उधारदाताओं के प्रस्तावों की तुलना करें। केवल एक प्रतिशत अंक की दर कमी भी सैकड़ों डॉलर बचा सकती है।

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **केवल भुगतान नहीं, कुल लागत पर विचार करें।** लंबी अवधि मासिक बिल घटाती है, लेकिन कुल ब्याज बढ़ाती है।

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **सर्टिफ़ाइड प्री-ओन्ड या थोड़ी पुरानी मॉडल देखें।** इनसे कीमत और बीमा लागत दोनों घट सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **हर साल अपने बीमा की तुलना करें।** एक ही ड्राइवर और वाहन के लिए दरें अलग-अलग बीमाकर्ताओं के बीच काफी भिन्न हो सकती हैं। छूट, ऊँची डिडक्टिबल और उपयोग-आधारित कार्यक्रमों के बारे में पूछें।

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **संघर्ष हो रहा हो तो उधारदाता से जल्दी बात करें।** उधारदाता स्थगन, संशोधित शर्तें या अन्य विकल्प दे सकते हैं। छूटी हुई किस्त के बाद इंतज़ार करने से विकल्प सीमित हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **पुनर्वित्त (रीफ़ाइनेंसिंग) पर विचार करें।** यदि आपका क्रेडिट सुधरा है या ऋण लेने के बाद दरें गिरी हैं, तो पुनर्वित्त से भुगतान कम हो सकता है। शुल्क जाँचें और अवधि इतनी न बढ़ाएँ कि अंत में अधिक भुगतान करना पड़े।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: कार रखने का मासिक खर्च ऊँची कीमतों, महँगे क्रेडिट और बढ़ते बीमा प्रीमियम के संयुक्त बोझ को दर्शाता है।

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: टैरिफ़ और मरम्मत लागत अनिश्चितता को और बढ़ाते हैं।

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: कई परिवारों के लिए नतीजा ऐसा बजट है जिसमें आश्चर्यों के लिए बहुत कम गुंजाइश बचती है, और बढ़ती भुगतान चूक बताती है कि एक बढ़ती संख्या अपनी सीमा तक पहुँच रही है।

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: संभावित खरीदार विज्ञापित भुगतान के बजाय स्वामित्व की पूरी लागत को ध्यान में रखकर योजना बनाकर खुद की रक्षा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and is not financial, legal or insurance advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य सूचना के उद्देश्य से है और वित्तीय, कानूनी या बीमा सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Consult a qualified professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: अपनी स्थिति के बारे में किसी योग्य पेशेवर से परामर्श करें।*

es.title: Impacto en el concesionario: por qué los pagos del coche y el seguro de auto están presionando a los conductores

segments.src: For many American households, the car is the second-largest monthly expense after housing.
segments.tr: Para muchos hogares estadounidenses, el coche es el segundo gasto mensual más alto después de la vivienda.

segments.src: It is also one of the few that is hard to cut.
segments.tr: Además, es uno de los pocos gastos difíciles de reducir.

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las personas necesita un vehículo para ir al trabajo, a la escuela y a citas médicas.

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: En los últimos tiempos, el costo de mantener uno ha subido en varios frentes a la vez: precios de lista más altos, financiamiento caro y primas de seguro que no dejan de aumentar.

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: Este artículo analiza lo que pagan los conductores, qué hay detrás de los aumentos y por qué una proporción creciente de prestatarios tiene dificultades para mantenerse al día.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: Las cifras son aproximadas y provienen de informes publicados por la industria.

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: Las cifras exactas varían según la fuente, la región y el período, así que consulte los datos actuales antes de tomar decisiones financieras.

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## Cómo es una cuota típica del coche

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: Organismos que siguen el mercado, como Edmunds y Experian, han informado en los últimos años que el pago mensual promedio de un préstamo para un vehículo nuevo supera con holgura los 700 dólares.

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: Los pagos por vehículos usados suelen superar los 500 dólares.

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: Un número creciente de compradores de coches nuevos paga 1000 dólares o más al mes.

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: Varios factores hacen subir estas cifras:

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **Precios más altos de los vehículos.** Según estimaciones de la industria, el precio promedio de transacción de un vehículo nuevo se ha mantenido cerca de los 48 000 dólares o por encima. Es mucho más que hace una década.

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **Plazos de préstamo más largos.** Los préstamos de 72 o 84 meses son ahora comunes. Reducen el pago mensual, pero aumentan el interés total y dejan a los compradores debiendo más de lo que vale el coche durante más tiempo.

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **Saldos de préstamo más grandes.** Muchos compradores trasladan a un nuevo préstamo el capital negativo de su vehículo entregado como parte de pago, lo que aumenta el monto financiado.

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## Costos de endeudamiento: el efecto de la tasa de interés

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: Después de que la Reserva Federal subiera las tasas de interés de forma marcada a partir de 2022, las tasas de los préstamos para coches siguieron la misma tendencia.

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: Las tasas promedio para coches nuevos se han situado, en general, entre el sector medio de un dígito y alrededor del 7 %, mientras que los préstamos para coches usados a menudo superan el 10 %.

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: Los prestatarios con puntajes de crédito más bajos pueden enfrentar tasas muy por encima del 10 %.

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: El efecto en la factura mensual es grande.

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: En un préstamo de 40 000 dólares a 72 meses, la diferencia entre una tasa del 5 % y una del 9 % equivale a unos 85 a 90 dólares más al mes, o a varios miles de dólares a lo largo de la vida del préstamo.

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: Incluso cuando los recortes de tasas empiezan a notarse, las tasas de los préstamos para coches tienden a bajar lentamente, y los prestamistas han mantenido criterios de crédito cautelosos para los prestatarios de mayor riesgo.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## Aranceles y el precio de los coches

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: La política comercial ha añadido otra capa de incertidumbre.

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: Los aranceles a los vehículos importados y a las piezas de automoción encarecen los costos de los fabricantes y proveedores.

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: Los fabricantes pueden absorber parte de ese costo, trasladarlo a los compradores o ajustar equipamientos y versiones para mantener los precios.

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: Los analistas no coinciden en cuánto de ese costo llega a los consumidores ni con qué rapidez, pero la mayoría espera presión al alza tanto en los precios de los vehículos nuevos como en los costos de reparación.

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: Los aranceles también importan fuera del concesionario.

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: Los precios más altos de las piezas pueden encarecer las reparaciones por colisión.

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: Eso, a su vez, alimenta los costos de las reclamaciones de seguro, que las aseguradoras tienen en cuenta al fijar las primas.

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## El seguro del coche sigue subiendo

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: El seguro ha sido uno de los factores más persistentes detrás del aumento de los costos de tener un coche.

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: Los datos de precios al consumidor muestran que los precios del seguro de auto han subido, durante buena parte de los últimos años, a un ritmo muy superior a la inflación general.

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: Las encuestas sobre tarifas sitúan el costo promedio de un seguro con cobertura completa en unos 2000 a 2700 dólares al año a nivel nacional, con cifras mucho más altas en estados como Florida, Míchigan, Luisiana y Nueva York.

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras señalan varias razones:

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **Reparaciones más costosas.** Los vehículos modernos incorporan sensores, cámaras y electrónica avanzada. Un pequeño golpe en la carrocería puede traducirse en una factura de reparación de miles de dólares.

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **Mayor severidad de las reclamaciones.** Los costos médicos y los valores de reposición de los vehículos han aumentado.

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **Clima severo y robos.** Granizadas, inundaciones e incendios forestales, junto con el robo de vehículos en algunas zonas, han elevado las pérdidas.

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **Costos legales y de fraude.** En algunos estados, las tendencias de litigios aumentan lo que pagan las aseguradoras.

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: Como los prestamistas exigen cobertura completa en los vehículos financiados, las primas más altas quedan, en la práctica, incorporadas al costo del crédito.

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## Juntando todo

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: Sume un pago de unos 750 dólares, una factura de seguro de 200 dólares o más al mes, y luego incluya combustible o carga eléctrica, mantenimiento, registro y estacionamiento.

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: El total puede alcanzar fácilmente de 1200 a 1500 dólares al mes en un hogar con un vehículo relativamente nuevo.

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: Para una familia con ingreso medio, eso representa una parte importante del salario neto.

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## Por qué más conductores se están quedando atrás

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: Los datos de morosidad reflejan la presión.

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: Los informes de las agencias de crédito y de calificación, entre ellas Fitch y la Reserva Federal de Nueva York, muestran que la morosidad de los préstamos para autos ha subido a niveles no vistos en años.

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: Los pagos atrasados entre prestatarios subprime han estado especialmente elevados.

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: Los saldos con morosidad grave, es decir, de 90 días o más de retraso, también han aumentado.

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: Entre los factores que contribuyen se encuentran:

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **Presupuestos ajustados.** Los precios de los alimentos, el alquiler y los servicios públicos han subido junto con los costos del coche.

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **Préstamos de tasa alta contratados en los últimos años.** Muchos prestatarios se comprometieron a financiamientos caros cuando las tasas estaban en su punto máximo.

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **Capital negativo.** Los propietarios que deben más de lo que vale el vehículo no pueden vender ni cambiarlo fácilmente para salir de la deuda.

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **Reanudación de los pagos de préstamos estudiantiles.** Para algunos prestatarios, la reanudación de los pagos ha reducido el margen en sus presupuestos mensuales.

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: En algunos casos, los prestamistas han respondido con criterios de aprobación más estrictos, mientras que las recuperaciones de vehículos han aumentado desde los mínimos de la pandemia.

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los conductores

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: No hay una solución rápida, pero algunas medidas pueden aliviar la presión:

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **Compare opciones de financiamiento primero.** Compare las ofertas de cooperativas de crédito, bancos y prestamistas en línea antes de visitar un concesionario. Incluso una reducción de un punto en la tasa puede ahorrar cientos de dólares.

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **Considere el costo total, no solo el pago.** Un plazo más largo reduce la factura mensual, pero aumenta el interés total.

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **Considere vehículos certificados de segunda mano o modelos un poco más antiguos.** Pueden reducir tanto el precio como el costo del seguro.

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **Compare su seguro cada año.** Las tarifas para el mismo conductor y vehículo pueden variar mucho entre aseguradoras. Pregunte por descuentos, deducibles más altos y programas basados en el uso.

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **Hable pronto con el prestamista si tiene dificultades.** Es posible que le ofrezcan aplazamientos, condiciones modificadas u otras opciones. Esperar a que haya un pago atrasado limita las alternativas.

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **Piense en refinanciar.** Si su historial de crédito ha mejorado o las tasas han bajado desde que obtuvo el préstamo, refinanciar puede reducir su pago. Revise las comisiones y evite extender tanto el plazo que termine pagando más al final.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En resumen

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: El costo mensual de tener un coche refleja el peso combinado de precios más altos, crédito caro y primas de seguro en aumento.

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: Los aranceles y los costos de reparación añaden más incertidumbre.

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: Para muchos hogares, el resultado es un presupuesto con poco margen para imprevistos, y el aumento de la morosidad sugiere que un número creciente de personas está llegando a su límite.

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: Quienes planean comprar pueden protegerse planificando en función del costo total de tener el coche, y no solo del pago anunciado.

ar.title: صدمة الأسعار في المعرض: لماذا تُثقل أقساط السيارات وتأمينها كاهل السائقين

segments.src: For many American households, the car is the second-largest monthly expense after housing.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لكثير من الأسر الأمريكية، تُعدّ السيارة ثاني أكبر نفقة شهرية بعد السكن.

segments.src: It is also one of the few that is hard to cut.
segments.tr: وهي أيضًا من النفقات القليلة التي يصعب خفضها.

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: فمعظم الناس يحتاجون إلى مركبة للوصول إلى العمل والمدرسة والمواعيد الطبية.

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: وفي الآونة الأخيرة، ارتفعت تكلفة امتلاك السيارة على عدة جبهات في وقت واحد: ارتفاع الأسعار المعلنة، وكلفة التمويل المرتفعة، واستمرار صعود أقساط التأمين.

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: يتناول هذا المقال ما يدفعه السائقون، وما يقف وراء الزيادات، ولماذا يواجه عدد متزايد من المقترضين صعوبة في مواكبة الالتزامات.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: الأرقام تقريبية ومستندة إلى تقارير صناعية منشورة.

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: وتختلف الأرقام الدقيقة باختلاف المصدر والمنطقة والفترة الزمنية، لذا تحقق من البيانات الحالية قبل اتخاذ أي قرار مالي.

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## كم يبلغ القسط الشهري المعتاد

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: تشير جهات متابعة القطاع مثل Edmunds وExperian إلى أن متوسط القسط الشهري لقرض السيارات الجديدة تجاوز في السنوات الأخيرة 700 دولار بوضوح.

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: أما أقساط السيارات المستعملة فتقع عادةً عند مستوى يتجاوز 500 دولار.

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: ويزداد عدد مشتري السيارات الجديدة الذين يتحملون أقساطًا تبلغ 1,000 دولار أو أكثر شهريًا.

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: تدفع عدة عوامل هذه الأرقام إلى الارتفاع:

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **ارتفاع أسعار المركبات.** بلغ متوسط سعر بيع السيارة الجديدة نحو 48,000 دولار أو أكثر، وفقًا لتقديرات الصناعة. وهو رقم أعلى بكثير مما كان عليه قبل عقد من الزمن.

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **إطالة مدة القروض.** أصبحت القروض لمدة 72 أو 84 شهرًا شائعة الآن. فهي تخفض القسط الشهري، لكنها ترفع إجمالي الفوائد وتجعل المشتري مدينًا بأكثر من قيمة السيارة لفترة أطول.

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **ارتفاع أصل مبلغ القرض.** يُدرج كثير من المشترين الفرق السلبي بين قيمة السيارة القديمة ومديونيتها عند استبدالها ضمن القرض الجديد، فيزيد ذلك المبلغ الممول.

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## تكلفة الاقتراض: أثر سعر الفائدة

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: بعد أن رفع الاحتياطي الفيدرالي أسعار الفائدة بحدة ابتداءً من عام 2022، تبعتها أسعار قروض السيارات.

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: ظلت متوسطات أسعار قروض السيارات الجديدة عمومًا في حدود منتصف خانة الرقم الواحد وحتى نحو 7%، بينما تتجاوز قروض السيارات المستعملة غالبًا 10%.

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: وقد يواجه المقترضون ذوو التصنيف الائتماني المنخفض أسعار فائدة تتجاوز بكثير 10%.

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: ينعكس ذلك بشكل كبير على القسط الشهري.

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: فعلى قرض بقيمة 40,000 دولار لمدة 72 شهرًا، يبلغ الفرق بين فائدة 5% وفائدة 9% نحو 85 إلى 90 دولارًا إضافية شهريًا، أي عدة آلاف من الدولارات على مدى عمر القرض.

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: وحتى عندما تبدأ تخفيضات أسعار الفائدة في الانعكاس، تميل أسعار إقراض السيارات إلى الانخفاض ببطء، وما زال المقرضون متشددين في معايير الائتمان مع المقترضين الأعلى مخاطرة.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## الرسوم الجمركية وأسعار السيارات

segments.tr: أضافت السياسات التجارية طبقة أخرى من عدم اليقين.

segments.tr: وقد اختلف المحللون حول مقدار ما يصل من هذه التكلفة إلى المستهلكين وسرعة وصولها، لكن معظمهم يتوقع ضغطًا تصاعديًا على أسعار المركبات الجديدة وتكاليف الإصلاح معًا.

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: وتتجاوز آثار الرسوم الجمركية حدود صالات العرض.

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: وهذا بدوره يرفع تكلفة المطالبات التأمينية، التي تأخذها شركات التأمين في الحسبان عند تحديد الأقساط.

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## أقساط التأمين على السيارات في ارتفاع مستمر

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: كان التأمين من أكثر العوامل ثباتًا في دفع تكاليف الملكية نحو الارتفاع.

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: وقد أظهرت بيانات أسعار المستهلك أن أسعار التأمين على السيارات ارتفعت بوتيرة تفوق التضخم العام بكثير خلال معظم السنوات القليلة الماضية.

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: وتشير مسوح الأسعار إلى أن متوسط تكلفة التأمين الشامل على مستوى البلاد يتراوح بين 2,000 و2,700 دولار سنويًا تقريبًا، مع أرقام أعلى بكثير في ولايات مثل فلوريدا وميشيغان ولويزيانا ونيويورك.

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: ويُرجع شركات التأمين ذلك إلى أسباب عدة:

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **ارتفاع تكاليف الإصلاح.** تحتوي المركبات الحديثة على أجهزة استشعار وكاميرات وإلكترونيات متقدمة. فقد تؤدي حادثة بسيطة إلى فاتورة إصلاح بالآلاف.

segments.tr: - **ارتفاع حجم المطالبات.** ارتفعت التكاليف الطبية وقيم استبدال المركبات.

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **الطقس القاسي والسرقة.** أدت العواصف البَرَدية والفيضانات وحرائق الغابات، إضافةً إلى سرقة المركبات في بعض المناطق، إلى ارتفاع الخسائر.

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **تكاليف قانونية واحتيال.** في بعض الولايات، تضيف اتجاهات التقاضي إلى ما تدفعه شركات التأمين من تعويضات.

segments.tr: ولأن المقرضين يشترطون التأمين الشامل على المركبات الممولة، فإن الأقساط المرتفعة تدخل عمليًا ضمن تكلفة الاقتراض.

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## الصورة الكاملة

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: أضف قسطًا يبلغ نحو 750 دولارًا إلى فاتورة تأمين لا تقل عن 200 دولار شهريًا، ثم أضف الوقود أو الشحن الكهربائي والصيانة والترخيص ومواقف السيارات.

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: قد يصل المجموع بسهولة إلى 1,200 إلى 1,500 دولار شهريًا للأسرة التي تملك مركبة حديثة.

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: وبالنسبة لأسرة ذات دخل متوسط، فإن هذا يمثل حصة كبيرة من الدخل الصافي.

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## لماذا يتخلف مزيد من السائقين عن السداد

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: تعكس بيانات التأخر عن السداد حجم الضغط.

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: فقد أظهرت تقارير مكاتب الائتمان وشركات التصنيف، ومنها Fitch والاحتياطي الفيدرالي في نيويورك، أن معدلات التأخر في سداد قروض السيارات ارتفعت إلى مستويات لم تُشاهد منذ سنوات.

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: وكان التأخر عن السداد لدى المقترضين دون الفئة الائتمانية الممتازة مرتفعًا بشكل خاص.

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: كما ازدادت الأرصدة المتأخرة بشدة، أي تلك المتأخرة 90 يومًا أو أكثر.

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: من العوامل المساهمة:

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **ميزانيات مشدودة.** ارتفعت أسعار البقالة والإيجار والمرافق جنبًا إلى جنب مع تكاليف السيارة.

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **قروض بفوائد مرتفعة أُبرمت في السنوات الأخيرة.** ثبّت كثير من المقترضين تمويلًا مكلفًا عندما كانت أسعار الفائدة في ذروتها.

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **السلبية في حقوق الملكية.** يدين أصحاب المركبات بأكثر من قيمة السيارة، فلا يستطيعون بيعها أو استبدالها بسهولة للخروج من الدين.

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **استئناف سداد قروض الطلاب.** بالنسبة لبعض المقترضين، أدى استئناف السداد إلى تقليص الهامش المتاح في الميزانية الشهرية.

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: وقد ردّ المقرضون في بعض الحالات بتشديد معايير منح القروض، في حين عادت حالات استرداد السيارات للارتفاع بعد أدنى مستوياتها خلال الجائحة.

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن للسائقين فعله

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: لا يوجد حل سريع، لكن بعض الخطوات قد تخفف الضغط:

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **قارن عروض التمويل أولًا.** قارن العروض من اتحادات الائتمان والبنوك والمقرضين عبر الإنترنت قبل زيارة الوكيل. فحتى خفض نقطة مئوية واحدة في سعر الفائدة قد يوفر مئات الدولارات.

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **انظر إلى التكلفة الإجمالية لا إلى القسط وحده.** تخفض المدة الأطول القسط الشهري، لكنها ترفع إجمالي الفائدة.

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **فكّر في السيارات المعتمدة المستعملة أو الموديلات الأقدم قليلًا.** قد يخفض ذلك كلًا من السعر وتكلفة التأمين.

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **قارن أسعار التأمين سنويًا.** قد تختلف الأسعار للسائق نفسه والمركبة نفسها اختلافًا كبيرًا بين شركات التأمين. اسأل عن الخصومات، والتحملات الأعلى، والبرامج القائمة على الاستخدام.

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **تحدّث مع المقرض مبكرًا إذا كنت تواجه صعوبة.** قد يقدّم المقرضون تأجيلات أو شروطًا معدّلة أو خيارات أخرى. أما الانتظار حتى بعد تفويت دفعة فيحدّ من الخيارات.

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **فكّر في إعادة التمويل.** إذا تحسّن ائتمانك أو انخفضت أسعار الفائدة منذ حصولك على القرض، فقد يخفض إعادة التمويل قسطك. تحقق من الرسوم، وتجنّب تمديد المدة إلى حد يجعلك تدفع أكثر في النهاية.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: تعكس تكلفة امتلاك السيارة شهريًا مجموع ثقل ارتفاع الأسعار وتكلفة الائتمان المرتفعة وزيادة أقساط التأمين.

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: وتضيف الرسوم الجمركية وتكاليف الإصلاح مزيدًا من عدم اليقين.

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: وبالنسبة لكثير من الأسر، تكون النتيجة ميزانية لا تترك مساحة تُذكر لأي طارئ، ويشير ارتفاع حالات التأخر في السداد إلى أن عددًا متزايدًا يبلغ حدوده القصوى.

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: ويمكن للمشترين المحتملين حماية أنفسهم بالتخطيط وفق التكلفة الكاملة للملكية، لا وفق القسط المعلن وحده.
