fr.title: Sticker Shock au concessionnaire : pourquoi les mensualités et l'assurance auto pèsent sur les conducteurs

segments.src: For many American households, the car is the second-largest monthly expense after housing.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux foyers américains, la voiture est la deuxième dépense mensuelle après le logement.

segments.src: It is also one of the few that is hard to cut.
segments.tr: C'est aussi l'une des rares dépenses difficiles à réduire.

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: La plupart des gens ont besoin d'un véhicule pour se rendre au travail, à l'école et à leurs rendez-vous médicaux.

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: Ces derniers temps, le coût de possession d'un véhicule a augmenté sur plusieurs fronts à la fois : prix catalogue plus élevés, financement coûteux et primes d'assurance qui n'ont cessé de grimper.

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: Cet article examine ce que paient les conducteurs, les raisons de ces hausses et pourquoi une part croissante d'emprunteurs peine à suivre.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: Les chiffres sont approximatifs et proviennent de rapports sectoriels publiés.

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: Les montants exacts varient selon la source, la région et la période, il convient donc de vérifier les données actuelles avant de prendre toute décision financière.

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## À quoi ressemble une mensualité type

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: Des organismes de suivi du secteur, comme Edmunds et Experian, ont indiqué ces dernières années que la mensualité moyenne d'un prêt pour véhicule neuf dépasse nettement 700 $.

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: Les mensualités pour un véhicule d'occasion se situent généralement au-dessus de 500 $.

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: Un nombre croissant d'acheteurs de voitures neuves paient 1 000 $ ou plus par mois.

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs font grimper ces montants :

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **Hausse des prix des véhicules.** Le prix de transaction moyen d'un véhicule neuf se situe autour de 48 000 $, voire au-dessus, selon les estimations sectorielles. C'est nettement plus qu'il y a dix ans.

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **Durées de prêt plus longues.** Les prêts de 72 ou 84 mois sont désormais courants. Ils réduisent la mensualité, mais augmentent le total des intérêts et laissent les acheteurs devoir davantage que la valeur du véhicule pendant plus longtemps.

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **Soldes de prêt plus importants.** Beaucoup d'acheteurs reportent la moins-value de leur véhicule repris à l'échange dans un nouveau prêt, ce qui augmente le montant financé.

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## Coût de l'emprunt : l'effet des taux d'intérêt

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: Après les fortes hausses de taux de la Réserve fédérale à partir de 2022, les taux des prêts auto ont suivi.

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: Les taux moyens des prêts pour véhicules neufs se situent généralement entre le milieu des chiffres simples et environ 7 %, tandis que ceux des prêts pour véhicules d'occasion dépassent souvent 10 %.

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: Les emprunteurs ayant un faible score de crédit peuvent se voir proposer des taux bien supérieurs à 10 %.

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: L'effet sur la mensualité est important.

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: Pour un prêt de 40 000 $ sur 72 mois, l'écart entre un taux de 5 % et un taux de 9 % représente environ 85 à 90 $ de plus par mois, soit plusieurs milliers de dollars sur la durée du prêt.

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: Même lorsque les baisses de taux commencent à se répercuter, les taux des prêts auto tendent à baisser lentement, et les prêteurs ont maintenu des critères de crédit prudents pour les emprunteurs les plus risqués.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## Droits de douane et prix des voitures

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: La politique commerciale ajoute une autre couche d'incertitude.

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: Les droits de douane sur les véhicules et pièces automobiles importés augmentent les coûts des constructeurs et des fournisseurs.

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: Les constructeurs peuvent absorber une partie de ce coût, le répercuter sur les acheteurs ou modifier les équipements et les finitions pour contenir les prix.

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: Les analystes ne s'accordent pas sur la part de ce coût qui atteint les consommateurs ni sur la rapidité de ce transfert, mais la plupart s'attendent à une pression à la hausse sur les prix des véhicules neufs comme sur les coûts de réparation.

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: Les droits de douane ont aussi des effets au-delà de la salle d'exposition.

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: Des pièces plus chères peuvent rendre les réparations après collision plus onéreuses.

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: Cela se répercute à son tour sur le coût des sinistres, que les assureurs prennent en compte pour fixer les primes.

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## L'assurance auto ne cesse de grimper

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: L'assurance est l'un des facteurs les plus persistants de la hausse du coût de possession.

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: Les données sur les prix à la consommation montrent que les prix de l'assurance auto ont progressé à un rythme bien supérieur à l'inflation générale pendant une grande partie des dernières années.

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: Selon les enquêtes sur les tarifs, le coût moyen d'une assurance tous risques se situe à environ 2 000 à 2 700 $ par an à l'échelle nationale, avec des montants beaucoup plus élevés dans des États comme la Floride, le Michigan, la Louisiane et New York.

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: Les assureurs évoquent plusieurs raisons :

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **Réparations plus coûteuses.** Les véhicules modernes contiennent capteurs, caméras et électronique avancée. Un simple accrochage peut donner lieu à une facture de réparation de plusieurs milliers de dollars.

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **Coût moyen plus élevé des sinistres.** Les frais médicaux et les valeurs de remplacement des véhicules ont augmenté.

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **Intempéries et vols.** La grêle, les inondations et les incendies de forêt, ainsi que le vol de véhicules dans certaines régions, ont fait grimper les pertes.

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **Frais juridiques et fraude.** Dans certains États, la tendance aux contentieux alourdit les indemnisations versées par les assureurs.

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: Comme les prêteurs exigent une couverture tous risques pour les véhicules financés, les primes plus élevées sont en pratique intégrées au coût de l'emprunt.

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## Mettre les choses en perspective

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: Ajoutez une mensualité d'environ 750 $ à une facture d'assurance de 200 $ ou plus par mois, puis incluez le carburant ou la recharge, l'entretien, l'immatriculation et le stationnement.

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: Le total peut facilement atteindre 1 200 à 1 500 $ par mois pour un foyer disposant d'un véhicule récent.

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: Pour une famille gagnant un revenu médian, cela représente une part importante du salaire net.

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi de plus en plus de conducteurs prennent du retard

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: Les données sur les retards de paiement traduisent cette pression.

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: Les rapports des bureaux de crédit et des agences de notation, dont Fitch et la Federal Reserve Bank of New York, montrent que les retards de paiement sur les prêts auto ont atteint des niveaux inédits depuis des années.

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: Les retards de paiement chez les emprunteurs subprime sont particulièrement élevés.

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: Les soldes gravement en retard, c'est-à-dire ceux en retard de 90 jours ou plus, ont également augmenté.

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: Les facteurs en cause sont notamment :

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **Budgets sous pression.** Les prix de l'alimentation, du loyer et des services publics ont augmenté en même temps que les coûts automobiles.

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **Prêts à taux élevé contractés ces dernières années.** Beaucoup d'emprunteurs ont souscrit un financement coûteux lorsque les taux étaient à leur plus haut.

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **Moins-value.** Les propriétaires qui doivent plus que la valeur du véhicule ne peuvent pas facilement le revendre ou le reprendre à l'échange pour en sortir.

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **Reprise des remboursements de prêts étudiants.** Pour certains emprunteurs, la reprise des remboursements a réduit la marge dans leur budget mensuel.

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: Dans certains cas, les prêteurs ont durci leurs critères de souscription, tandis que les saisies de véhicules ont augmenté par rapport à leurs niveaux les plus bas pendant la pandémie.

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les conducteurs peuvent faire

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: Il n'existe pas de solution rapide, mais certaines mesures peuvent alléger la pression :

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **Comparez d'abord les financements.** Comparez les offres des caisses de crédit, des banques et des prêteurs en ligne avant de vous rendre chez un concessionnaire. Même une baisse d'un point de taux peut faire économiser des centaines de dollars.

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **Considérez le coût total, pas seulement la mensualité.** Une durée plus longue réduit la mensualité, mais augmente le total des intérêts.

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **Envisagez un véhicule d'occasion certifié ou un modèle un peu plus ancien.** Cela peut réduire à la fois le prix et le coût de l'assurance.

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **Comparez vos assurances chaque année.** Pour un même conducteur et un même véhicule, les tarifs peuvent varier fortement d'un assureur à l'autre. Renseignez-vous sur les réductions, les franchises plus élevées et les programmes basés sur l'usage.

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **Parlez-en tôt à votre prêteur si vous êtes en difficulté.** Les prêteurs peuvent proposer des reports, des conditions modifiées ou d'autres solutions. Attendre après un retard de paiement limite les choix.

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **Pensez au refinancement.** Si votre crédit s'est amélioré ou si les taux ont baissé depuis la souscription de votre prêt, un refinancement peut réduire votre mensualité. Vérifiez les frais et évitez d'allonger la durée au point de payer davantage au final.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: Le coût mensuel de possession d'une voiture reflète le poids cumulé de prix plus élevés, d'un crédit coûteux et de primes d'assurance en hausse.

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: Les droits de douane et les coûts de réparation ajoutent encore de l'incertitude.

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux foyers, le résultat est un budget qui laisse peu de place aux imprévus, et la hausse des retards de paiement suggère qu'un nombre croissant de ménages atteignent leurs limites.

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: Les acheteurs potentiels peuvent se protéger en planifiant à partir du coût total de possession plutôt que de la seule mensualité affichée.

pt.title: Choque de preços no pátio: por que as parcelas do carro e o seguro auto apertam os motoristas

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: A maioria das pessoas precisa de um veículo para ir ao trabalho, à escola e a consultas médicas.

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: Ultimamente, o custo de manter um carro subiu em várias frentes ao mesmo tempo: preços de tabela mais altos, financiamento caro e prêmios de seguro que não param de subir.

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: Este artigo analisa quanto os motoristas estão pagando, o que está por trás dos aumentos e por que uma parcela crescente dos tomadores de crédito tem dificuldade para acompanhar.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: Os números são aproximados e baseados em relatórios publicados pelo setor.

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: Os valores exatos variam conforme a fonte, a região e o período, então confira os dados atuais antes de tomar decisões financeiras.

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## Como é uma prestação típica de carro

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: Rastreadores do setor, como Edmunds e Experian, têm relatado nos últimos anos que a prestação mensal média de um financiamento de veículo novo fica bem acima de US$ 700.

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: As prestações de veículos usados costumam ficar acima de US$ 500.

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: Um número crescente de compradores de carros novos paga US$ 1.000 ou mais por mês.

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: Vários fatores puxam esses valores para cima:

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **Preços de veículos mais altos.** O preço médio de transação de veículos novos tem se mantido perto de US$ 48.000 ou acima disso, segundo estimativas do setor. Isso é muito mais do que há uma década.

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **Prazos de financiamento mais longos.** Financiamentos de 72 ou 84 meses são hoje comuns. Eles reduzem a prestação mensal, mas aumentam os juros totais e deixam o comprador devendo mais do que o carro vale por mais tempo.

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **Saldos financiados maiores.** Muitos compradores rolam para um novo financiamento o saldo negativo da troca do carro antigo, o que aumenta o valor financiado.

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## Custo do crédito: o efeito da taxa de juros

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: Depois que o Federal Reserve elevou bruscamente as taxas de juros a partir de 2022, as taxas de financiamento de veículos acompanharam.

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: As taxas médias de financiamento de carros novos ficaram, em geral, entre o meio de um dígito e cerca de 7%, enquanto os financiamentos de carros usados frequentemente ultrapassam 10%.

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: Tomadores com pontuação de crédito mais baixa podem enfrentar taxas bem acima de dois dígitos.

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: O efeito na conta mensal é grande.

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: Em um financiamento de US$ 40.000 em 72 meses, a diferença entre uma taxa de 5% e uma de 9% é de cerca de US$ 85 a US$ 90 a mais por mês, ou vários milhares de dólares ao longo do contrato.

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: Mesmo quando os cortes de juros começam a chegar ao consumidor, as taxas de financiamento de veículos tendem a cair devagar, e os credores mantiveram critérios de concessão cautelosos para tomadores de maior risco.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## Tarifas e o preço dos carros

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: A política comercial acrescentou outra camada de incerteza.

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: As tarifas sobre veículos e autopeças importados elevam os custos para fabricantes e fornecedores.

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: As montadoras podem absorver parte desse custo, repassá-lo aos compradores ou ajustar equipamentos e versões para manter os preços.

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: Analistas discordam sobre quanto desse custo chega ao consumidor e com que rapidez, mas a maioria espera pressão de alta tanto nos preços de veículos novos quanto nos custos de reparo.

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: As tarifas também importam para além da concessionária.

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: Preços mais altos de peças podem tornar os reparos de colisão mais caros.

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: Isso, por sua vez, alimenta o custo dos sinistros, que as seguradoras consideram ao definir os prêmios.

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## O seguro auto continua subindo

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: O seguro tem sido um dos fatores mais persistentes na alta do custo de manter um veículo.

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: Dados de preços ao consumidor mostram que o seguro auto subiu em ritmo bem acima da inflação geral na maior parte dos últimos anos.

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: Levantamentos de taxas indicam que o custo médio do seguro com cobertura total fica em torno de US$ 2.000 a US$ 2.700 por ano em todo o país, com valores muito maiores em estados como Flórida, Michigan, Louisiana e Nova York.

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: As seguradoras apontam vários motivos:

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **Reparos mais caros.** Os veículos modernos têm sensores, câmeras e eletrônica avançada. Uma batidinha leve na lataria pode gerar uma conta de milhares de dólares.

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **Maior gravidade dos sinistros.** Os custos médicos e os valores de reposição dos veículos aumentaram.

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **Clima severo e roubo.** Granizo, enchentes e incêndios florestais, além do roubo de veículos em algumas regiões, aumentaram as perdas.

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **Custos jurídicos e de fraude.** Em alguns estados, a tendência de litígios aumenta o que as seguradoras pagam.

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: Como os credores exigem cobertura total em veículos financiados, os prêmios mais altos acabam embutidos, na prática, no custo do crédito.

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## Juntando tudo

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: Some uma prestação de cerca de US$ 750 a uma conta de seguro de US$ 200 ou mais por mês, e depois inclua combustível ou recarga, manutenção, licenciamento e estacionamento.

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: O total pode facilmente chegar a US$ 1.200 a US$ 1.500 por mês para uma família com um veículo mais novo.

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: Para uma família com renda mediana, isso representa uma parcela significativa da renda líquida.

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## Por que mais motoristas estão ficando para trás

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: Os dados de inadimplência refletem essa pressão.

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: Relatórios de bureaus de crédito e agências de classificação de risco, incluindo a Fitch e o Federal Reserve Bank de Nova York, mostram que a inadimplência dos financiamentos de veículos subiu a níveis não vistos em anos.

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: Os atrasos entre tomadores subprime têm sido especialmente elevados.

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: Os saldos em atraso grave, com 90 dias ou mais de atraso, também aumentaram.

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: Entre os fatores que contribuem estão:

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **Orçamentos apertados.** Os preços de alimentos, aluguel e serviços públicos subiram junto com os custos do carro.

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **Financiamentos caros contratados nos últimos anos.** Muitos tomadores travaram financiamentos caros quando as taxas estavam no pico.

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **Saldo negativo.** Proprietários que devem mais do que o veículo vale não conseguem vender ou trocar o carro com facilidade para sair da dívida.

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **Retomada dos pagamentos de empréstimos estudantis.** Para alguns tomadores, a retomada das parcelas reduziu a folga no orçamento mensal.

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: Em alguns casos, os credores responderam com critérios de análise mais rígidos, enquanto as retomadas de veículos subiram em relação às mínimas da pandemia.

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## O que os motoristas podem fazer

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: Não existe solução rápida, mas algumas medidas podem aliviar a pressão:

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **Pesquise o financiamento primeiro.** Compare propostas de cooperativas de crédito, bancos e financeiras online antes de ir a uma concessionária. Mesmo uma redução de um ponto percentual na taxa pode economizar centenas de dólares.

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **Considere o custo total, não apenas a prestação.** Um prazo maior reduz a conta mensal, mas aumenta os juros totais.

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **Considere veículos seminovos certificados ou modelos um pouco mais antigos.** Eles podem reduzir tanto o preço quanto o custo do seguro.

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **Renove o seguro todo ano e compare.** As taxas para o mesmo motorista e veículo podem variar muito entre seguradoras. Pergunte sobre descontos, franquias mais altas e programas baseados no uso.

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **Converse cedo com o credor se estiver com dificuldades.** Os credores podem oferecer adiamentos, condições alteradas ou outras opções. Esperar até depois de um atraso limita as escolhas.

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **Pense em refinanciar.** Se seu crédito melhorou ou as taxas caíram desde que você contratou o financiamento, refinanciar pode reduzir a prestação. Verifique as taxas e evite estender tanto o prazo a ponto de pagar mais no final.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: O custo mensal de ter um carro reflete o peso combinado de preços mais altos, crédito caro e prêmios de seguro em alta.

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: Tarifas e custos de reparo acrescentam mais incerteza.

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: Para muitas famílias, o resultado é um orçamento com pouco espaço para imprevistos, e o aumento da inadimplência sugere que um número crescente de pessoas está chegando ao limite.

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: Quem pretende comprar pode se proteger planejando com base no custo total de propriedade, e não apenas na prestação anunciada.

in.title: Sticker Shock di Dealer: Mengapa Cicilan Mobil dan Asuransi Otomotif Menekan Pengendara

segments.src: For many American households, the car is the second-largest monthly expense after housing.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak rumah tangga di Amerika, mobil adalah pengeluaran bulanan terbesar kedua setelah perumahan.

segments.src: It is also one of the few that is hard to cut.
segments.tr: Ini juga salah satu pengeluaran yang sulit dipangkas.

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: Kebanyakan orang membutuhkan kendaraan untuk pergi bekerja, sekolah, dan menghadiri janji temu medis.

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: Belakangan ini, biaya memiliki mobil naik dari berbagai arah sekaligus: harga jual yang lebih tinggi, pembiayaan yang mahal, dan premi asuransi yang terus naik.

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: Artikel ini membahas berapa yang dibayar pengendara, apa penyebab kenaikannya, dan mengapa semakin banyak peminjam kesulitan mengikutinya.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: Angka-angka ini bersifat perkiraan dan diambil dari laporan industri yang dipublikasikan.

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: Angka pastinya bervariasi menurut sumber, wilayah, dan periode waktu, jadi periksa data terbaru sebelum membuat keputusan keuangan.

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## Seperti apa cicilan mobil pada umumnya

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: Pelacak industri seperti Edmunds dan Experian dalam beberapa tahun terakhir melaporkan bahwa rata-rata cicilan bulanan untuk pinjaman mobil baru jauh di atas $700.

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: Cicilan untuk mobil bekas umumnya berada di atas $500.

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: Semakin banyak pembeli mobil baru yang harus membayar $1,000 atau lebih per bulan.

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: Beberapa faktor mendorong angka-angka ini naik:

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **Harga kendaraan yang lebih tinggi.** Rata-rata harga transaksi kendaraan baru bertahan di sekitar atau di atas $48,000, menurut perkiraan industri. Angka itu jauh lebih tinggi dibanding satu dekade lalu.

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **Tenor pinjaman yang lebih panjang.** Pinjaman 72 atau 84 bulan kini umum. Tenor tersebut memang menurunkan cicilan bulanan, tetapi meningkatkan total bunga dan membuat pembeli lebih lama berutang melebihi nilai mobilnya.

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **Saldo pinjaman yang lebih besar.** Banyak pembeli menggabungkan selisih utang di atas nilai mobil (negative equity) dari tukar tambah ke pinjaman baru, sehingga jumlah yang dibiayai ikut bertambah.

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## Biaya pinjaman: efek suku bunga

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: Setelah Federal Reserve menaikkan suku bunga secara tajam mulai tahun 2022, suku bunga pinjaman mobil ikut naik.

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: Rata-rata suku bunga untuk pinjaman mobil baru umumnya berada di kisaran satu digit menengah hingga sekitar 7%, sedangkan pinjaman mobil bekas sering melebihi 10%.

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: Peminjam dengan skor kredit rendah bisa menghadapi suku bunga jauh di atas dua digit.

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: Dampaknya pada tagihan bulanan sangat besar.

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: Untuk pinjaman $40,000 dengan tenor 72 bulan, selisih antara suku bunga 5% dan 9% kira-kira $85 hingga $90 lebih mahal per bulan, atau beberapa ribu dolar selama masa pinjaman.

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: Bahkan ketika pemotongan suku bunga mulai terasa, suku bunga pinjaman otomotif cenderung turun perlahan, dan pemberi pinjaman tetap berhati-hati dalam menerapkan standar kredit bagi peminjam yang berisiko lebih tinggi.

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## Tarif dan harga mobil

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: Kebijakan perdagangan menambah lapisan ketidakpastian lainnya.

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: Tarif untuk kendaraan dan suku cadang impor menaikkan biaya bagi produsen dan pemasok.

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: Pabrikan mungkin menanggung sebagian biaya tersebut, meneruskannya kepada pembeli, atau menyesuaikan fitur dan varian untuk menjaga harga.

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: Para analis berbeda pendapat tentang seberapa besar biaya itu sampai ke konsumen dan seberapa cepat, tetapi sebagian besar memperkirakan tekanan naik pada harga kendaraan baru maupun biaya perbaikan.

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: Tarif juga berdampak di luar showroom.

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: Harga suku cadang yang lebih tinggi dapat membuat perbaikan akibat tabrakan menjadi lebih mahal.

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: Hal ini pada gilirannya memengaruhi biaya klaim asuransi, yang diperhitungkan perusahaan asuransi saat menetapkan premi.

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## Asuransi otomotif terus naik

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: Asuransi termasuk salah satu faktor yang paling konsisten mendorong naiknya biaya kepemilikan kendaraan.

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: Data harga konsumen menunjukkan harga asuransi mobil naik jauh di atas laju inflasi umum selama sebagian besar beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: Survei tarif menempatkan rata-rata biaya asuransi lengkap (full coverage) sekitar $2,000 hingga $2,700 per tahun secara nasional, dengan angka yang jauh lebih tinggi di negara bagian seperti Florida, Michigan, Louisiana, dan New York.

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi menunjuk beberapa alasan:

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **Perbaikan yang lebih mahal.** Kendaraan modern dilengkapi sensor, kamera, dan elektronik canggih. Benturan ringan pada bodi bisa berarti tagihan perbaikan hingga ribuan dolar.

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **Tingkat keparahan klaim yang lebih tinggi.** Biaya medis dan nilai penggantian kendaraan telah meningkat.

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **Cuaca ekstrem dan pencurian.** Kejadian hujan es, banjir, dan kebakaran hutan, serta pencurian kendaraan di beberapa wilayah, telah mendorong naik kerugian.

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **Biaya hukum dan penipuan.** Di beberapa negara bagian, tren litigasi menambah jumlah yang harus dibayarkan perusahaan asuransi.

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: Karena pemberi pinjaman mewajibkan asuransi lengkap pada kendaraan yang dibiayai, premi yang lebih tinggi pada praktiknya ikut tertanam dalam biaya meminjam.

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## Menyatukan semuanya

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: Tambahkan cicilan sekitar $750 dengan tagihan asuransi $200 atau lebih per bulan, lalu tambahkan bahan bakar atau pengisian daya, perawatan, biaya registrasi, dan parkir.

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: Totalnya bisa dengan mudah mencapai $1,200 hingga $1,500 per bulan bagi rumah tangga dengan kendaraan yang lebih baru.

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: Bagi keluarga dengan pendapatan median, jumlah itu merupakan porsi besar dari gaji bersih.

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## Mengapa semakin banyak pengendara tertinggal

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: Data tunggakan mencerminkan tekanan tersebut.

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: Laporan dari biro kredit dan lembaga pemeringkat, termasuk Fitch dan Federal Reserve Bank of New York, menunjukkan tunggakan pinjaman mobil naik ke tingkat yang belum terlihat dalam beberapa tahun.

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: Keterlambatan pembayaran di kalangan peminjam subprime khususnya sangat tinggi.

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: Saldo yang menunggak parah, yakni 90 hari atau lebih, juga meningkat.

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: Faktor penyebabnya antara lain:

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **Anggaran yang tertekan.** Harga bahan makanan, sewa, dan utilitas naik bersamaan dengan biaya mobil.

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **Pinjaman berbunga tinggi yang diambil dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.** Banyak peminjam terikat pada pembiayaan mahal ketika suku bunga berada di puncaknya.

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **Negative equity.** Pemilik yang berutang lebih besar daripada nilai kendaraannya tidak dapat dengan mudah menjual atau menukar kendaraan untuk keluar dari beban tersebut.

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **Pembayaran pinjaman mahasiswa yang kembali berjalan.** Bagi sebagian peminjam, pembayaran yang dimulai kembali telah mengurangi ruang dalam anggaran bulanan.

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa kasus, pemberi pinjaman merespons dengan proses penilaian kredit yang lebih ketat, sementara penarikan kendaraan (repossession) telah naik dari titik terendahnya selama pandemi.

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang bisa dilakukan pengendara

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: Tidak ada solusi instan, tetapi beberapa langkah dapat mengurangi tekanan:

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan pembiayaan terlebih dahulu.** Bandingkan penawaran dari koperasi kredit, bank, dan pemberi pinjaman daring sebelum mengunjungi dealer. Bahkan penurunan suku bunga satu poin dapat menghemat ratusan dolar.

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan total biaya, bukan hanya cicilan.** Tenor yang lebih panjang menurunkan tagihan bulanan tetapi menaikkan total bunga.

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan mobil bekas bersertifikat (certified pre-owned) atau model yang sedikit lebih tua.** Keduanya dapat menurunkan harga sekaligus biaya asuransi.

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan asuransi Anda setiap tahun.** Tarif untuk pengemudi dan kendaraan yang sama bisa sangat berbeda antarperusahaan asuransi. Tanyakan tentang diskon, risiko sendiri (deductible) yang lebih tinggi, dan program berbasis penggunaan.

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **Hubungi pemberi pinjaman lebih awal jika Anda kesulitan.** Pemberi pinjaman mungkin menawarkan penundaan, perubahan ketentuan, atau opsi lain. Menunggu sampai setelah pembayaran terlewat akan membatasi pilihan.

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan refinancing.** Jika kredit Anda membaik atau suku bunga turun sejak Anda mengambil pinjaman, refinancing mungkin dapat menurunkan cicilan. Periksa biaya dan hindari memperpanjang tenor sedemikian rupa sehingga Anda membayar lebih banyak di akhir.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: Biaya bulanan memiliki mobil mencerminkan beban gabungan dari harga yang lebih tinggi, kredit yang mahal, dan premi asuransi yang naik.

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: Tarif dan biaya perbaikan menambah ketidakpastian.

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak rumah tangga, hasilnya adalah anggaran yang menyisakan sedikit ruang untuk kejutan, dan naiknya tunggakan menunjukkan bahwa semakin banyak orang mencapai batasnya.

segments.src: Prospective buyers can protect themselves by planning around the full cost of ownership rather than the advertised payment alone.
segments.tr: Calon pembeli dapat melindungi diri dengan merencanakan berdasarkan total biaya kepemilikan, bukan hanya cicilan yang diiklankan.

segments.tr: Konsultasikan dengan profesional yang berkualifikasi tentang situasi Anda sendiri.*

ja.title: 駐車場での価格ショック：自動車ローンと自動車保険がドライバーを圧迫する理由

segments.src: For many American households, the car is the second-largest monthly expense after housing.
segments.tr: 多くのアメリカの世帯にとって、自動車は住居費に次ぐ月間の二番目に大きな支出です。

segments.src: It is also one of the few that is hard to cut.
segments.tr: また、削りにくい数少ない支出のひとつでもあります。

segments.src: Most people need a vehicle to get to work, school and medical appointments.
segments.tr: ほとんどの人は、通勤・通学や通院のために車を必要としています。

segments.src: Lately, the cost of keeping one has climbed on several fronts at once: higher sticker prices, expensive financing and insurance premiums that have kept rising.
segments.tr: 近年は、車を維持する費用があらゆる面で同時に上昇しています。車両の定価の上昇、高額な融資金利、そして上がり続ける保険料です。

segments.src: This article looks at what drivers are paying, what is behind the increases, and why a growing share of borrowers are struggling to keep up.
segments.tr: この記事では、ドライバーがどれだけ支払っているのか、値上がりの背景には何があるのか、そして返済に苦しむ借り手が増えている理由を取り上げます。

segments.src: Figures are approximate and drawn from published industry reports.
segments.tr: 数値は概算で、業界の公開レポートに基づいています。

segments.src: Exact numbers vary by source, region and time period, so check current data before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: 正確な数値は情報源・地域・期間によって異なるため、金銭的な判断を下す前に最新のデータを確認してください。

segments.src: ## What a typical car payment looks like
segments.tr: ## 一般的な自動車ローンの月額支払い

segments.src: Industry trackers such as Edmunds and Experian have reported in recent years that the average monthly payment on a new vehicle loan is well above $700.
segments.tr: EdmundsやExperianなどの業界調査機関は近年、新車ローンの平均月額支払いが700ドルをかなり上回っていると報告しています。

segments.src: Used-vehicle payments commonly land somewhere above $500.
segments.tr: 中古車の月額支払いは、通常500ドル超の水準です。

segments.src: A growing number of new-car buyers carry payments of $1,000 or more per month.
segments.tr: 新車購入者のうち、月1,000ドル以上の支払いを抱える人も増えています。

segments.src: Several things push these figures up:
segments.tr: こうした数字を押し上げている要因は次のとおりです：

segments.src: - **Higher vehicle prices.** The average new vehicle transaction price has hovered near or above $48,000, according to industry estimates. That is far higher than a decade ago.
segments.tr: - **車両価格の上昇。** 業界の推計によると、新車の平均取引価格は48,000ドル前後か、それを上回る水準で推移しています。これは10年前と比べてはるかに高い水準です。

segments.src: - **Longer loan terms.** Loans of 72 or 84 months are now common. They lower the monthly payment but increase total interest and leave buyers owing more than the car is worth for longer.
segments.tr: - **ローン期間の長期化。** 72か月や84か月のローンが今では一般的です。月々の支払いは減りますが、利息総額は増え、購入者が車の価値より多く借金を抱える期間も長くなります。

segments.src: - **Larger loan balances.** Many buyers roll negative equity from a trade-in into a new loan, which adds to the amount financed.
segments.tr: - **借入残高の増加。** 多くの購入者は下取り時のネガティブ・エクイティ（残債超過分）を新しいローンに組み込んでおり、借入額が増えています。

segments.src: ## Borrowing costs: the interest rate effect
segments.tr: ## 借入コスト：金利の影響

segments.src: After the Federal Reserve raised interest rates sharply beginning in 2022, auto loan rates followed.
segments.tr: 連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が2022年から政策金利を大幅に引き上げた後、自動車ローンの金利も上昇しました。

segments.src: Average rates on new-car loans have generally run in the mid-single digits to around 7%, while used-car loans often exceed 10%.
segments.tr: 新車ローンの平均金利はおおむね中盤の一桁台から7%前後で推移しており、中古車ローンは10%を超えることも少なくありません。

segments.src: Borrowers with lower credit scores can face rates well into the double digits.
segments.tr: 信用スコアが低い借り手は、金利が二桁台に達することもあります。

segments.src: The effect on the monthly bill is large.
segments.tr: 月々の支払いへの影響は大きいです。

segments.src: On a $40,000, 72-month loan, the difference between a 5% rate and a 9% rate is roughly $85 to $90 more per month, or several thousand dollars over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: 40,000ドル・72か月のローンの場合、金利5%と9%の差は月額でおよそ85〜90ドル、ローン期間全体では数千ドルの違いになります。

segments.src: Even when rate cuts begin to filter through, auto lending rates tend to ease slowly, and lenders have kept credit standards cautious for riskier borrowers.
segments.tr: 金利引き下げの効果が波及し始めても、自動車ローン金利は緩やかにしか下がらない傾向があり、リスクの高い借り手に対して貸し手は依然として慎重な審査基準を維持しています。

segments.src: ## Tariffs and the price of cars
segments.tr: ## 関税と車の価格

segments.src: Trade policy has added another layer of uncertainty.
segments.tr: 通商政策も、もうひとつの不確実性の要因になっています。

segments.src: Tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts raise costs for manufacturers and suppliers.
segments.tr: 輸入車や自動車部品への関税は、メーカーやサプライヤーのコストを押し上げます。

segments.src: Automakers may absorb some of that cost, pass it on to buyers, or adjust features and trim levels to hold prices.
segments.tr: 自動車メーカーは、そのコストの一部を吸収するか、購入者に転嫁するか、価格を維持するために装備やグレードを調整するかもしれません。

segments.src: Analysts have disagreed on how much of the cost reaches consumers and how quickly, but most expect upward pressure on both new-vehicle prices and repair costs.
segments.tr: 関税コストのどれだけが消費者に届き、どれくらいの速さで届くかについては、アナリストの見解は分かれていますが、新車価格と修理費の両方に上昇圧力がかかると見る向きがほとんどです。

segments.src: Tariffs also matter beyond the showroom.
segments.tr: 関税の影響は、ショールームの外にも及びます。

segments.src: Higher parts prices can make collision repairs more expensive.
segments.tr: 部品価格が上がると、事故車の修理費も高くなります。

segments.src: That in turn feeds into insurance claims costs, which insurers consider when setting premiums.
segments.tr: それが保険金の支払コストを押し上げ、保険会社は保険料を設定する際にこの点を考慮します。

segments.src: ## Auto insurance keeps climbing
segments.tr: ## 自動車保険は上がり続けている

segments.src: Insurance has been one of the more persistent contributors to rising ownership costs.
segments.tr: 保険は、所有コストの上昇を持続的に押し上げている要因の一つです。

segments.src: Consumer price data has shown auto insurance prices rising at a pace well above general inflation for much of the past few years.
segments.tr: 消費者物価統計によると、過去数年の大半で自動車保険料は一般的なインフレ率をはるかに上回るペースで上昇してきました。

segments.src: Surveys of rates put the average cost of full-coverage insurance at roughly $2,000 to $2,700 per year nationally, with much higher figures in states such as Florida, Michigan, Louisiana and New York.
segments.tr: 料金に関する調査では、全国の包括補償（フルカバー）保険の平均額は年間およそ2,000〜2,700ドルとされていますが、フロリダ州・ミシガン州・ルイジアナ州・ニューヨーク州などではそれよりはるかに高い額になっています。

segments.src: Insurers point to several reasons:
segments.tr: 保険会社は次のような理由を挙げています：

segments.src: - **Costlier repairs.** Modern vehicles contain sensors, cameras and advanced electronics. A minor fender bender can mean a repair bill in the thousands.
segments.tr: - **修理費の上昇。** 現代の車にはセンサー、カメラ、高度な電子機器が搭載されています。軽い接触事故でも、修理費が数千ドルに達することがあります。

segments.src: - **Higher claim severity.** Medical costs and vehicle replacement values have increased.
segments.tr: - **保険金支払額の増加。** 医療費や車両の買い替え価格が上昇しています。

segments.src: - **Severe weather and theft.** Hail, flooding and wildfire events, along with vehicle theft in some areas, have driven up losses.
segments.tr: - **悪天候と盗難。** ひょう、洪水、山火事などの気象災害や、一部地域での車両盗難によって損害額が増えています。

segments.src: - **Legal and fraud costs.** In some states, litigation trends add to what insurers pay out.
segments.tr: - **訴訟・詐欺関連のコスト。** 一部の州では、訴訟の傾向によって保険会社の支払額がさらに増えています。

segments.src: Because lenders require full coverage on financed vehicles, higher premiums are effectively built into the cost of borrowing.
segments.tr: ローンで購入した車には貸し手が包括補償を義務付けているため、保険料の上昇は実質的に借入コストに組み込まれています。

segments.src: ## Putting it together
segments.tr: ## まとめ

segments.src: Add a payment of roughly $750 to an insurance bill of $200 or more per month, then include fuel or charging, maintenance, registration and parking.
segments.tr: 月額およそ750ドルの車両ローン返済に、月200ドル以上の保険料を加えてください。さらに燃料または充電費用、整備費、登録料、駐車場代も含めます。

segments.src: The total can easily reach $1,200 to $1,500 a month for a household with a newer vehicle.
segments.tr: 新しめの車を所有する世帯では、合計で月1,200〜1,500ドルに容易に達します。

segments.src: For a family earning a median income, that is a significant share of take-home pay.
segments.tr: 中央値の所得の家庭にとって、これは手取り収入のかなり大きな割合です。

segments.src: ## Why more drivers are falling behind
segments.tr: ## ますます多くのドライバーが支払いに行き詰まる理由

segments.src: Delinquency data reflects the strain.
segments.tr: 延滞データにはその負担が表れています。

segments.src: Reports from credit bureaus and ratings agencies, including Fitch and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, have shown auto loan delinquencies rising to levels not seen in years.
segments.tr: 信用情報機関や格付け会社の報告、たとえばFitchやニューヨーク連邦準備銀行の報告では、自動車ローンの延滞率が数年ぶりの水準まで上昇していることが示されています。

segments.src: Late payments among subprime borrowers have been especially elevated.
segments.tr: 特にサブプライム層の借り手の延滞は、とりわけ高い水準にあります。

segments.src: Seriously delinquent balances, those 90 days or more past due, have also increased.
segments.tr: 90日以上延滞している深刻な延滞残高も増えています。

segments.src: Contributing factors include:
segments.tr: その要因として次のようなものがあります：

segments.src: 1. **Stretched budgets.** Prices for groceries, rent and utilities have risen alongside car costs.
segments.tr: 1. **家計の逼迫。** 食料品、家賃、光熱費の価格が、車の費用と並行して上昇しています。

segments.src: 2. **High-rate loans taken in recent years.** Many borrowers locked in expensive financing when rates were at their peak.
segments.tr: 2. **近年に組まれた高金利ローン。** 多くの借り手は、金利がピークにあった時期に高額な融資を固定してしまいました。

segments.src: 3. **Negative equity.** Owners who owe more than the vehicle is worth cannot easily sell or trade their way out.
segments.tr: 3. **ネガティブ・エクイティ。** 車の価値より残債が多い所有者は、売却や下取りで抜け出すことが容易ではありません。

segments.src: 4. **Resumed student loan payments.** For some borrowers, restarted repayments have reduced the room in monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 4. **学生ローン返済の再開。** 一部の借り手にとっては、返済の再開によって月々の家計の余裕が減りました。

segments.src: Lenders have responded in some cases with tighter underwriting, while repossessions have risen from their pandemic lows.
segments.tr: 一部の貸し手は審査を厳しくして対応しており、また差し押さえ（引き揚げ）件数もパンデミック期の底から増加しています。

segments.src: ## What drivers can do
segments.tr: ## ドライバーにできること

segments.src: There is no quick fix, but some steps can reduce the pressure:
segments.tr: 即効性のある解決策はありませんが、負担を軽減できる方法はいくつかあります：

segments.src: - **Shop for financing first.** Compare offers from credit unions, banks and online lenders before visiting a dealer. Even a one-point rate reduction can save hundreds of dollars.
segments.tr: - **まず融資条件を比較する。** ディーラーを訪れる前に、信用組合・銀行・オンライン貸金業者から見積もりを比べてください。金利がわずか1%下がるだけでも、数百ドルの節約になることがあります。

segments.src: - **Consider total cost, not just the payment.** A longer term lowers the monthly bill but raises overall interest.
segments.tr: - **支払額だけでなく総コストで考える。** 期間を長くすると月々の支払いは減りますが、利息の総額は増えます。

segments.src: - **Look at certified pre-owned or slightly older models.** These can reduce both the price and the insurance cost.
segments.tr: - **認定中古車（CPO）や少し古いモデルを検討する。** これらは車両価格と保険料の両方を抑えられる場合があります。

segments.src: - **Shop your insurance annually.** Rates for the same driver and vehicle can differ widely among insurers. Ask about discounts, higher deductibles and usage-based programs.
segments.tr: - **保険は毎年比較する。** 同じ運転者・同じ車でも、保険会社によって料金が大きく異なることがあります。割引、より高い免責額、走行距離連動型（UBI）プログラムについて尋ねてみてください。

segments.src: - **Talk to the lender early if you are struggling.** Lenders may offer deferrals, modified terms or other options. Waiting until after a missed payment limits choices.
segments.tr: - **返済が苦しければ早めに貸し手に相談する。** 貸し手は支払猶予、条件変更などの選択肢を提供してくれる場合があります。支払いを一度滞納してからでは、選択肢が限られます。

segments.src: - **Think about refinancing.** If your credit has improved or rates have fallen since you took out the loan, refinancing may lower your payment. Check for fees and avoid extending the term so far that you pay more in the end.
segments.tr: - **借り換えを検討する。** 信用スコアが改善したり、ローンを組んだ時より金利が下がっていれば、借り換えで月々の支払いを減らせるかもしれません。手数料を確認し、結局より多く支払うことになるほど期間を延ばさないようにしてください。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The monthly cost of owning a car reflects the combined weight of higher prices, expensive credit and rising insurance premiums.
segments.tr: 車を所有する月額コストは、車両価格の上昇、高額な信用コスト、保険料の上昇が重なった結果を反映しています。

segments.src: Tariffs and repair costs add further uncertainty.
segments.tr: 関税や修理費は、さらに不確実性を加えています。

segments.src: For many households, the result is a budget that leaves little room for surprises, and rising delinquencies suggest that a growing number are reaching their limit.
